method: Built-in image_gen edit calls; no pixel editing, resizing, alpha replacement or upscale applied.

chart.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: sharp seamless website world-map backdrop, 16:9 landscape, largest supported output ideally 3840x2160.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Make a faithful cleanup of this exact image, not a redesign.
Primary request: remove the complete sailing ship, every sail/mast/rope, its entire dark cast shadow, and ALL of the broad yellow dashed travel route. Reconstruct the underlying map naturally and precisely in those areas.
LOCK all unedited appearance: identical continent positions, proportions, geography and coastline silhouettes; identical oblique camera and 16:9 composition (Americas left, Europe/Africa center, Asia right, Australia lower right); identical dark detailed navy ocean, violet-blue textured continents with fine golden coastline/borders and weathered engraved surface; identical dramatic warm sunbeam from upper right. Retain the detailed realistic 3D material finish, subtle depth and original map relief. Do not flatten into a vector or cel-shaded map.
The cleaned map must continue smoothly beneath the ship's former location and route. No ship or craft, no sails, no ship-shaped residual shadow, no broad dashed marks, no path, no X, no symbols, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no text, no watermark. Preserve natural map islands and coast detailing. The entire frame should contain only this exact clean map with original upper-right light. Razor-sharp clean continent edges and rich fine texture.
chart.inspection: Visually confirmed no craft, cast shadow, route, X, text or labels. Map composition, dark blue/violet/gold texture and upper-right sunbeam closely follow reference. Geographical surfaces behind ship reconstructed by generator, not exact original hidden pixels.

ship.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a transparent sailing-ship asset needing ONLY an alpha/framing cleanup. Input image 2 is the original identity/style reference.
Preserve the ship in image 1 exactly: same ship silhouette, camera, direction, rigging, three masts, sail design, colors, dark wood hull, sunlit cream canvas, detail and lighting. Do not redesign or rotate. The ship must remain sharp and richly detailed.
Change only these defects:
1. Clean ALL contaminated pink/red/yellow/white fringe and haze from the transparent gaps around rigging/sails and outside silhouette. No colored halo, no white backdrop patches. Empty gaps are actual fully transparent alpha.
2. Every solid wooden hull, rail, mast and canvas sail surface is fully opaque (alpha255); no ghostlike translucency. Transparent pixels must not punch holes into solid wood or canvas. Only anti-aliased silhouette edges use fractional alpha, and rigging gaps/open background use zero alpha.
3. Reframe the exact same complete ship centered inside a square canvas with at least 8 percent fully transparent padding on ALL four sides; nothing touches or is clipped by edges. Aim for 1536 or 2048 square if supported.
Whole ship only, no floor, shadow, map, water, route, X, marks, text, extra objects. Same warm upper-right light and realistic fine rope/wood/canvas detail. Genuine clean transparent RGBA background.

inspection.alphaNoiseNote: Very low alpha noise extends to full canvas bounds; alpha16 bounding box shows visually significant content.
limitations: Generated re-render preserves broad identity but not exact source pixels.
Requested 8% padding was not obeyed; horizontal padding is about 1%, vertical about 7%.
Solid materials are nearly opaque alpha252-253 rather than consistently255.
Fine colored fringe residue remains in some rigging gaps in transparent preview. Parent should inspect on actual backdrop.

No backdrop of any color; no map, no ground/floor, no water, no horizon, no route, no dash marks, no X, no label/text, no watermark, no baked ground shadow or surrounding glow.
